title: Nan'ao Island RO flexibility — illustrative scenario simulation

assumptions.event_duration_hours_distribution: lognormal with median 8 h and sigma=0.5, clipped to [2, 24] h
assumptions.available_surplus_power_kw_distribution: triangular(5, 50, mode=25) kW during an event
assumptions.standby_ro_status: No publicly accessible official documentation reviewed by the team confirms an operable standby seawater RO unit on Nan'ao main island. The pilot assumes a modular 50 kW RO unit would be procured, installed and owned by the local water authority, subject to site verification, approval and budget.
assumptions.data_status: assumptions only; no measured Nan'ao curtailment time series supplied
exclusions: No hourly grid power-flow, network congestion, export-limit or dispatch simulation
No measured renewable generation, demand, curtailment or outage-event dataset
No water demand, reservoir constraints, water-quality approval or plant ramp/flush model
No CAPEX/OPEX, savings, ROI, emissions or avoided-outage claims
No claim that the modeled events actually occurred on Nan'ao

interpretation: Scenario-based simulation assumption, not measured real-world data. Percentiles describe only the stated assumptions; they are not a forecast, guarantee, validated water yield, or evidence of actual Nan'ao curtailment.
